subject: Future Tech
title: Level 2: Where We Are Now
description: Learn Level 2: Where We Are Now in one minute.

hook.text: Tesla Autopilot, GM Super Cruise, Ford BlueCruise—they all sound autonomous. They're all Level 2.

buildup.text: Level 2 handles steering and speed together.

discovery.text: Driver monitoring cameras track eye gaze and head position.

twist.text: The name 'Autopilot' misleads drivers into overtrusting the system.

climax.text: The NHTSA investigated Tesla over 40 crashes involving Autopilot.

punchline.text: Assisted driving is not autonomous driving. The name matters.

quiz.question: Why have there been fatal crashes with Level 2 systems?
options: Drivers overtrusted the system and stopped paying attention
The cars couldn't detect other vehicles
